a.xlink:title: Makes the widgets, empty until a loaded document is set.
Lists the delays of the selected scenario again and keeps the selected row where it still exists.
Shows the fields of the selected delay again.
A combo box that expands across its row and fits its size hint to its entries.
Takes the occurrence from its field.
Takes the delay in seconds from its field.
Takes the station at index of the station combo.
A spin box whose wheel is guarded by FocusWheel.
Deletes the selected delay after the user has confirmed it.
Inserts a copy of the selected delay after it.
False while no scene is loaded or a run uses it.
The panel has changed the document. Emitted after SceneDocument::changed().
True when a scene is loaded.
The time in seconds over which the occurrences of a service are counted. The panel must have a docume...
Guards box: gives it strong focus and installs a Filter, once.
The selected delay, or null when none is selected or the scene cannot be edited.
A Yes or No question whose default answer is No; true for Yes. It asks also in a suppressed run.
